note: These are 25 different physical questions, not 25 parameter points. All primary URLs were opened or returned by primary-source search. Specific panel extraction and numerical adapters remain as stated. None was executed in this roadmap task. R1/R2/R3/R4 denote increasing expected development/computation scope, not runtime estimates.

candidates.title: Published spatial entanglement profile of an interacting Hubbard chain
candidates.question: Recover the complete ground-state cut profile and its shape, rather than one small-cluster entropy value.
candidates.model_geometry: Periodic half-filled one-dimensional repulsive Hubbard chain; published L=64,U/t=2 setup, Fig.5.
candidates.ensemble: Fixed-number ground-state DMRG; projector DQMC only after projection convergence; finite-beta replacement requires separate thermal bound.
candidates.observable_normalization: S2(A)=-ln Tr rho_A^2 in nats for contiguous A; compare profile differences after the same allowed additive fit constant.
candidates.oracle: Broecker and Trebst Fig.5 DMRG/projector-DQMC profile and stated gapless-sector interpretation.
candidates.acceptance: Freeze digitization errors and a common cut window; simultaneous entropy-difference intervals must fit an absolute 0.02-nat margin after finite-temperature and truncation budgets are bounded.

resources.unknowns: Published length/projection convergence, required MPS bond dimension, estimator variance.

candidates.adapter_status: Existing chain estimators; new published-profile ingestion and projection/thermal matching adapter.
candidates.overlap_note: One scientific profile test. Do not count every cut or a separate CFT-fit row as additional ideas; distinct from initial tiny-chain QuSpin scalar checks.

candidates.title: Thermal conversion of the entropy arc into a volume profile
candidates.question: Reproduce the change of the whole subsystem-size entropy curve during heating.
candidates.model_geometry: Half-filled periodic Hubbard chain, L=32,U/t=2; published Fig.6 temperature range.
candidates.ensemble: Grand-canonical thermal state at matched beta and centered chemical potential.
candidates.observable_normalization: S2(l) in nats; the spatial profile includes thermal contributions and need not obey pure-state complement equality.
candidates.oracle: Broecker and Trebst Fig.6.
candidates.acceptance: At preregistered low/intermediate/high temperatures, whole-profile residual intervals must lie inside 0.03 nats plus source digitization uncertainty; separately converge dtau.

resources.unknowns: Monte Carlo autocorrelation and weak overlap at large joined regions.

candidates.adapter_status: Existing finite-temperature entropy capability; new profile campaign and source-curve adapter.
candidates.overlap_note: One temperature-crossover phenomenon, not one idea per beta or cut. Keep separate from high-temperature atomic/free identities.

candidates.title: Finite-system purity crossover scale
candidates.question: Match the published size dependence of the temperature below which the full chain becomes effectively pure.
candidates.model_geometry: Half-filled Hubbard rings with the sizes and interactions in published Fig.8.
candidates.ensemble: Grand-canonical thermal state, retaining charge sectors.
candidates.observable_normalization: P(T)=exp[-S2(full chain)]; define a fixed P=0.95 crossover only where the published curve resolves it.
candidates.oracle: Broecker and Trebst Fig.8 finite-size purity curves.
candidates.acceptance: Preregister interpolation and uncertainty; extracted crossover must agree within 10% or the source-resolution limit, whichever is larger; insufficient low-temperature reach is unresolved.

resources.unknowns: Full-region entropy variance and low-temperature stabilization costs.

candidates.adapter_status: Existing entropy capability; new crossover extraction and controlled-beta adapter.
candidates.overlap_note: Distinct target is the published finite-size crossover scale; do not duplicate the analytic identity P=Z(2beta)/Z(beta)^2 as another journal idea.

candidates.title: Quarter-filled shell-filling anomaly in entanglement
candidates.question: Resolve the additional entropy contribution between L=0 mod8 and L=4 mod8 rings.
candidates.model_geometry: Quarter-filled spinful Hubbard rings, total N=L/2 and Nup=Ndown=L/4; paper-selected U and chain sizes.
candidates.ensemble: Fixed-sector ground state, preserving the paper ground multiplet prescription.
candidates.observable_normalization: S2(l) in nats; use branch differences at the same l/L and remove only the explicitly shared nonuniversal offset.
candidates.oracle: Essler, Laeuchli and Calabrese published entropy curves and shell-filling correction.
candidates.acceptance: Reproduce the sign and x=l/L dependence of the extra contribution; require 0.02-nat simultaneous agreement after finite-size and source-reading errors.

resources.unknowns: Long rings, marginal corrections, possible degenerate ground states.

candidates.adapter_status: Existing ED/DMRG basis can be generalized; add quarter-filling driver and full ground-subspace gate.
candidates.overlap_note: This is quarter filling and mod8, not the user half-filled mod4 finite-size branches. Do not conflate them.

candidates.title: Spinon and holon branches of the removal spectrum
candidates.question: Recover two distinct interacting dispersing spectral edges over a substantial momentum range.
candidates.model_geometry: Doped one-dimensional Hubbard chain with the published open boundaries, filling and hopping.
candidates.ensemble: Fixed-N zero-temperature removal spectrum, final N-1 sectors.
candidates.observable_normalization: Aminus(k,omega)=sum_m |<m,N-1|c_k,sigma|GS,N>|^2 delta(omega-energy difference); use the paper sine-wave momentum convention and energy zero.
candidates.oracle: Benthien, Gebhard and Jeckelmann dynamical-DMRG results and their Bethe-ansatz edge comparison.
candidates.acceptance: With the same broadening and momentum window, both branch locations must agree within max(0.05t, source line width); spectral weights must be compared separately from edge locations.

resources.unknowns: Frequency solver or real-time evolution length, finite-size/broadening tradeoff.

candidates.adapter_status: New correction-vector/Chebyshev or time-evolution spectral adapter required.
candidates.overlap_note: One separation-of-branches benchmark; do not count each k, branch, or U as separate ideas.

candidates.title: Optical absorption edge of the one-dimensional Mott insulator
candidates.question: Reproduce the published near-threshold square-root onset in the optical conductivity.
candidates.model_geometry: Half-filled one-dimensional repulsive Hubbard chain; paper geometry and weak/intermediate-coupling window.
candidates.ensemble: Zero-temperature fixed-number current response.
candidates.observable_normalization: Re sigma(omega) from the current-current Kubo response with the same current operator, chain-length normalization and Lorentzian width as the paper.
candidates.oracle: Jeckelmann, Gebhard and Essler threshold analysis and dynamical-DMRG absorption spectrum.
candidates.acceptance: Preregister fit window outside the artificial broadening scale; threshold location within 0.03t and onset exponent compatible with 1/2 after size/broadening extrapolation.

resources.unknowns: Resolution near a small charge gap and long-chain frequency calculations.

candidates.adapter_status: New current operator and frequency-response adapter.
candidates.overlap_note: Not a repeat of the Lieb-Wu charge-gap scalar: it tests optical selection rules and edge line shape.

candidates.title: Bound optical exciton in the extended Hubbard chain
candidates.question: Separate a bound absorption pole from the unbound holon-antiholon continuum using the published extended-model result.
candidates.model_geometry: Half-filled one-dimensional extended Hubbard chain, including the paper nearest-neighbor density interaction V.
candidates.ensemble: Zero-temperature fixed-N current response.
candidates.observable_normalization: Bound-pole energy, integrated oscillator strength and continuum threshold, using the published current normalization.
candidates.oracle: Essler, Gebhard and Jeckelmann exciton calculation.
candidates.acceptance: At matched parameters, pole and continuum separation agree within max(0.03t, source resolution), with finite-size sharpening distinguished from an imposed broadening peak.

resources.unknowns: Extra interaction implementation and high-resolution dynamics.

candidates.adapter_status: NOT_SUPPORTED_CURRENT_HAMILTONIAN: add nearest-neighbor V and independently verify its operator convention first.
candidates.overlap_note: Distinct bound-state physics, not another optical-curve U point; cannot use V>0 reference as a test of the present onsite-only model.

candidates.title: Thermally activated in-gap charge resonance
candidates.question: Reproduce the low-frequency density-response feature inside the zero-temperature Mott gap.
candidates.model_geometry: Half-filled strong-coupling Hubbard chain with the paper finite-temperature setup.
candidates.ensemble: Canonical or grand-canonical finite-temperature state exactly matching the selected published panel.
candidates.observable_normalization: Snn(q,omega) for connected density fluctuations; use the paper positive-frequency and detailed-balance convention.
candidates.oracle: Nocera, Essler and Feiguin published finite-temperature Villain-like resonance.
candidates.acceptance: Match the resonance dispersion within max(0.05t, source frequency resolution) and its integrated low-energy weight within 10%, after thermal/broadening errors are budgeted.

resources.unknowns: Purification/METTS convergence, real-time reach and low-weight feature resolution.

candidates.adapter_status: New finite-temperature dynamical density adapter.
candidates.overlap_note: Different physical observable from one-particle spectral splitting; do not treat every temperature panel as another idea.

candidates.title: Spin-incoherent redistribution of electron spectral weight
candidates.question: Recover the published temperature-driven spectral reconstruction when spin disordering precedes charge excitation.
candidates.model_geometry: Strong-coupling half-filled Hubbard chain, using finite U parameters from the selected paper panel.
candidates.ensemble: Finite-temperature thermal ensemble matched to the publication; not an artificial spin-temperature ensemble.
candidates.observable_normalization: A(k,omega) with the same energy zero, spin sum and spectral normalization.
candidates.oracle: Nocera, Essler and Feiguin finite-U thermal spectral crossover.
candidates.acceptance: Use preregistered spectral-window weights and peak positions: weights within 10%, positions within max(0.05t, source line width); do not certify a crossover from an entropy estimate alone.

resources.unknowns: Thermal state preparation and dynamical entanglement growth.

candidates.adapter_status: New finite-temperature one-particle dynamics or controlled continuation adapter.
candidates.overlap_note: One thermal spin-incoherence phenomenon, distinct from zero-temperature spinon/holon edge matching.

candidates.title: Boundary-induced bound state in the local spectrum
candidates.question: Recover the nondispersing in-gap state created by a boundary potential.
candidates.model_geometry: Open half-filled Hubbard chain with the boundary potential and, where selected, V used by the paper.
candidates.ensemble: Fixed-number ground-state local addition/removal spectrum.
candidates.observable_normalization: Local spectral weight at each boundary distance; integrate the bound peak using the same broadening and electron normalization.
candidates.oracle: Schoenauer, Schmitteckert and Schuricht published LDOS boundary-state result.
candidates.acceptance: Bound-pole energy within max(0.03t, source line width) and spatial decay profile within 5% after finite-length convergence; a generic spin-charge doublet is insufficient.

resources.unknowns: Boundary-potential adapter and frequency resolution.

candidates.adapter_status: Add local boundary potential and LDOS measurement; choose V=0 panel or explicitly add V.
candidates.overlap_note: A localized boundary bound state is a distinct phenomenon from bulk spin-charge separation and an optical exciton.

candidates.title: Hidden antiferromagnetic string correlations in doped chains
candidates.question: Recover magnetic correlations revealed by removing the signs accumulated across charge defects.
candidates.model_geometry: Hole-doped Hubbard chains at the published U, temperature and experimental postselection.
candidates.ensemble: Finite-temperature number-sector mixture or conditioned canonical ensemble matching the measured selection.
candidates.observable_normalization: Raw 4<Sz_i exp[i pi sum_{i<k<j}(1-n_k)] Sz_j> and the paper endpoint/selection normalization; retain raw and conditioned forms.
candidates.oracle: Hilker et al. string-correlation measurements and accompanying Hubbard calculations.
candidates.acceptance: Simultaneous string-correlator intervals within 0.03 plus experimental/theory reference uncertainty, after applying the same detection and conditioning rules.

resources.unknowns: Nonlocal measurement variance and faithful experimental selection.

candidates.adapter_status: New string-observable and postselection adapter.
candidates.overlap_note: Not a simple two-point-spin test; do not count ordinary and string versions as two ideas unless the target scientific question differs.

candidates.title: Density-driven incommensurate magnetic wave vector
candidates.question: Recover the published spin modulation wave vector as carriers are removed.
candidates.model_geometry: Balanced doped Hubbard chains with the finite lengths, confinement and filling groups used in the source.
candidates.ensemble: Finite-temperature spin-balanced ensemble, conditioned on the same atom-number groups.
candidates.observable_normalization: Connected Szz(q)=L^-1 sum_ij exp[iq(ri-rj)]<Sz_i Sz_j>c; record windowing and the paper normalization.
candidates.oracle: Salomon et al. incommensurate-magnetism data and Hubbard calculations.
candidates.acceptance: Peak positions follow the published doping dependence within one resolved momentum bin; correlation-profile amplitudes within source uncertainty and a preregistered 0.03 absolute margin.

resources.unknowns: Finite-chain Fourier windows, density inhomogeneity and doped-DQMC sign.

candidates.adapter_status: New structure-factor campaign and conditional-density driver.
candidates.overlap_note: One interaction-dependent wave-vector law, not one test per density; distinct from hidden string restoration.

candidates.title: Longer-range spin correlations as a Hubbard-chain thermometer
candidates.question: Match the simultaneous finite-temperature decay pattern at separations one through three.
candidates.model_geometry: Near-half-filled one-dimensional Hubbard chains at the publication interaction and confinement.
candidates.ensemble: Thermal state with the same spin balance and postselection.
candidates.observable_normalization: Connected spin correlations through distance three, using physical Sz=(nup-ndown)/2 before any published factor-four normalization.
candidates.oracle: Boll et al. spin/density-resolved data and associated finite-temperature Hubbard calculations.
candidates.acceptance: One common temperature must describe all distances within experimental uncertainty plus a fixed 0.02 absolute correlation margin; fitting each distance separately is not a pass.

resources.unknowns: Accurate temperature calibration, trap matching and measurement efficiency.

candidates.adapter_status: Existing equal-time quantities; add common-temperature multi-distance fit and selection model.
candidates.overlap_note: Not the zero-temperature Heisenberg nearest-neighbor scalar; physical target is joint finite-temperature correlation range.

candidates.title: Real-time separation of a locally created spin and charge disturbance
candidates.question: Track the two propagation fronts after the same local atom-removal quench.
candidates.model_geometry: Open Hubbard chain at the published interaction and density, with matched weak confinement where needed.
candidates.ensemble: Published initial thermal preparation followed by unitary real-time evolution after local removal.
candidates.observable_normalization: Hole density and spin-correlation disturbance in lattice sites versus time in hbar/t; use a common preregistered front estimator.
candidates.oracle: Vijayan et al. time-resolved spin-charge deconfinement data and theory.
candidates.acceptance: Both front velocities and their ratio agree within 10% plus source uncertainty; vary time step and truncation to exclude numerical front splitting.

resources.unknowns: Thermal initialization and real-time bond growth.

candidates.adapter_status: New local-quench and time-evolution adapter.
candidates.overlap_note: Distinct real-space nonequilibrium test; do not also count each velocity as a separate benchmark idea.

candidates.title: Separated spin and charge peaks in the square-lattice specific heat
candidates.question: Resolve the published low- and high-temperature thermodynamic structures.
candidates.model_geometry: Half-filled two-dimensional nearest-neighbor square Hubbard lattice; match the published finite sizes and U.
candidates.ensemble: Grand-canonical thermal state at particle-hole symmetry.
candidates.observable_normalization: Cv per physical site, consistently derived from internal energy or an independently validated thermal estimator; entropy per site uses kB=1.
candidates.oracle: Paiva et al. specific-heat curves.
candidates.acceptance: Peak positions within 10% and integrated entropy within 0.03 per site after dtau, size and derivative-error bounds; two noisy extrema alone are insufficient.

resources.unknowns: Many temperature points, energy derivatives and finite-size effects.

candidates.adapter_status: Requires square-lattice one-orbital finite-temperature adapter and controlled derivative analysis.
candidates.overlap_note: One two-energy-scale phenomenon, not an energy-versus-U sweep or a separate idea per peak.

candidates.title: Low-temperature feature in the local moment
candidates.question: Recover the additional low-energy structure in local moment formation beyond the broad interaction-scale crossover.
candidates.model_geometry: Same half-filled square-lattice Hubbard model and selected published finite-size setup.
candidates.ensemble: Particle-hole-symmetric thermal ensemble.
candidates.observable_normalization: m_loc^2=< (nup-ndown)^2 > per site; separate this from physical <S^2>=3 m_loc^2/4.
candidates.oracle: Paiva et al. local-moment temperature dependence.
candidates.acceptance: Preregister the temperature window and derivative sign/feature location; raw moment curve within 0.01 and feature scale within 10%, with simultaneous uncertainties.

resources.unknowns: Small low-temperature feature and temperature-grid resolution.

candidates.adapter_status: New square-lattice temperature campaign; onsite measurement already standard.
candidates.overlap_note: Different observable and physical question from the specific-heat peak structure; do not count a mere moment identity as this benchmark.

candidates.title: Momentum-selective onset of the weak-coupling pseudogap
candidates.question: Match the different cooling behavior of nodal and antinodal one-particle quantities.
candidates.model_geometry: Half-filled nearest-neighbor square Hubbard lattice at the weak-coupling parameters and finite-size treatment of the source.
candidates.ensemble: Grand-canonical finite-temperature state.
candidates.observable_normalization: G(k,beta/2) and/or Matsubara self-energy at the source nodal/antinodal momenta with identical spin and Fourier normalization.
candidates.oracle: Schaefer et al. numerically exact reference curves, not their approximate-method curves.
candidates.acceptance: Matsubara quantities within 0.02t for self-energy or 0.02 absolute Green-function margin plus reference uncertainty; reproduce the ordering of crossover temperatures after size convergence.

resources.unknowns: Large AF correlation length and low-temperature finite-size requirements.

candidates.adapter_status: New one-orbital square-lattice momentum Green-function adapter.
candidates.overlap_note: If external-package category uses this same publication, reserve that row for another observable; do not count method names as separate physics ideas.

candidates.title: Spin texture conditional on an isolated dopant
candidates.question: Recover the spatial spin-correlation distortion surrounding a hole instead of averaging it away.
candidates.model_geometry: Lightly hole-doped two-dimensional square Hubbard system matched to the published measurement/theory setup.
candidates.ensemble: Finite-temperature state with the same isolated-hole selection.
candidates.observable_normalization: Conditional connected correlation <h0 Sz_i Sz_j>/<h0>-<Sz_i Sz_j>, with h0=(1-nup0)(1-ndown0); use the source spin factors and remove disconnected pieces consistently.
candidates.oracle: Koepsell et al. magnetic-polaron spin maps and accompanying theory.
candidates.acceptance: A preregistered set of relative positions must agree within experimental/theory error plus 0.03 absolute conditional correlation; unresolved hole statistics are not a pass.

resources.unknowns: Rare-event three-point statistics, doped sign problem and confinement.

candidates.adapter_status: New conditional higher-point spin/density measurement adapter.
candidates.overlap_note: Distinct from unconditioned AF correlations and from the one-dimensional string observable.

candidates.title: Physical stripe amplitude versus DMRG-induced density modulation
candidates.question: Reproduce the published extrapolation separating genuine strong-coupling stripes from numerical modulation at weak coupling.
candidates.model_geometry: Six-leg Hubbard cylinders, periodic around the legs and open along the length; published lengths and hole sectors.
candidates.ensemble: Fixed-number ground state with matched boundary/pinning prescription.
candidates.observable_normalization: Rung-averaged hole density and its modulation amplitude; track discarded weight and length as separate extrapolations.
candidates.oracle: Hager et al. stripe-formation study.
candidates.acceptance: Follow the source extrapolation protocol: strong-coupling amplitude remains nonzero within confidence limits while weak-coupling modulation vanishes; fixed-bond pictures alone do not pass.

resources.unknowns: Large cylinder bond dimensions and multi-size extrapolation; memory/timing unknown until pilot.

candidates.adapter_status: NOT_SUPPORTED_CURRENT_CHAIN_DRIVER: new cylinder MPO and converged DMRG campaign required.
candidates.overlap_note: One stripe-certification question, not separate U=3 and U=12 ideas; do not duplicate a generic bond-dimension test.

candidates.title: Two-orbital electron and hole Fermi-pocket topology
candidates.question: Recover the published pocket types and their locations for the minimal iron-pnictide model.
candidates.model_geometry: Square-lattice dxz/dyz two-orbital tight-binding model at the exact Raghu hopping and chemical potential; not the different ALM hopping set.
candidates.ensemble: Noninteracting zero-temperature Fermi sea, with finite-temperature extrapolation if using DQMC.
candidates.observable_normalization: Band occupation boundaries in the unfolded one-Fe zone; explicitly map any folded two-Fe presentation before counting pockets.
candidates.oracle: Raghu et al. published band/Fermi-surface construction.
candidates.acceptance: Pocket count and connectivity must match, with Fermi contour locations within one converged mesh spacing and Luttinger filling within 1e-3 per cell.

resources.unknowns: Momentum-grid refinement and Brillouin-zone unfolding.

candidates.adapter_status: Existing two-orbital kinetic capability; new published-parameter and contour adapter.
candidates.overlap_note: Tests a Fermi-surface topology, not generic eigenvalue agreement or one idea per momentum.

candidates.title: Orbital mixing in the two-band spectral weights
candidates.question: Recover redistribution between dxz and dyz character across hybridized band crossings.
candidates.model_geometry: Same published two-orbital tight-binding model and orbital convention.
candidates.ensemble: Noninteracting Fermi sea or matched thermal Gaussian state.
candidates.observable_normalization: Orbital-resolved spectral residues |u_alpha,nu(k)|^2 per spin, rather than only eigenvalues; sum of orbital weights per band is one.
candidates.oracle: Published Bloch Hamiltonian/eigenvectors of Raghu et al.; proposed residue benchmark derived from those equations, not a claimed digitized experimental curve.
candidates.acceptance: At selected paths crossing a hybridization region, residues within 1e-8 of independently evaluated published two-band expressions and crossing transfer of orbital weight reproduced.

resources.unknowns: Gauge/orbital convention matching; no large simulation expected.

candidates.adapter_status: Add orbital-projected spectral-residue measurement; no interaction extension needed.
candidates.overlap_note: Distinct physical orbital character. If analytic25 already includes precisely this two-band spectral-residue question, replace this candidate rather than double-count.

candidates.title: Nesting-driven wave-vector selection in the bare spin response
candidates.question: Recover the published response maximum near stripe wave vectors instead of inferring magnetism solely from bands.
candidates.model_geometry: Published Raghu two-orbital square-lattice parameters and temperature.
candidates.ensemble: U=0 thermal linear response.
candidates.observable_normalization: Use exactly the published orbital-matrix bubble definition, including its -1/(2N) normalization and band coherence factors; distinguish it from a scalar-spin convention.
candidates.oracle: Raghu et al. Eq.6 and bare part of Fig.4.
candidates.acceptance: Susceptibility along the published momentum path agrees within 2% after mesh/temperature convergence, with the same dominant peak wave vector.

resources.unknowns: k-mesh and near-degenerate energy-denominator treatment.

candidates.adapter_status: New orbital-resolved susceptibility adapter.
candidates.overlap_note: Do not use the interacting U=V=6 RPA curve as an exact U-only DQMC target. One response-landscape question, not one case per q.

candidates.title: Hybridization selection between orbital-antiparallel and parallel mean-field states
candidates.question: Reproduce the published intraorbital-only mean-field energetic mechanism for local orbital antialignment.
candidates.model_geometry: Giuli-Mejuto-Zaera-Capone two-orbital square model, using the AppendixD small-interorbital-hybridization setup.
candidates.ensemble: Specified Hartree-Fock trial states at matched density; this is a variational functional benchmark, not a certification of the exact ground state.
candidates.observable_normalization: Canonical energy difference per cell between matched orbital-parallel and orbital-antiparallel trial Slater states, with interaction double counting included.
candidates.oracle: Published AppendixD mean-field argument; gRISB phase boundaries are not the quantitative oracle for an HF/ED calculation.
candidates.acceptance: In the stated perturbative window, match the published leading hybridization dependence and energy ordering; absolute trial-state energy difference within 1e-6 per cell after momentum convergence.

resources.unknowns: Choosing a valid common-density perturbative window and avoiding unsupported global-phase claims.

candidates.adapter_status: New independent Slater-trial-state expectation adapter around existing two-orbital/HF capability.
candidates.overlap_note: Not another exact-ground-energy sweep. Keep separate from gRISB phase reproduction, which requires a different approximation; replace if analytic25 already covers this AppendixD result.

candidates.title: Published stripe magnetism of the interacting two-orbital pnictide cluster
candidates.question: Recover the magnetic structure-factor pattern in the original finite-cluster model.
candidates.model_geometry: Published square cluster and hoppings of Daghofer et al., including its interorbital repulsion, Hund exchange and any pair-hopping terms exactly as specified.
candidates.ensemble: Undoped fixed-number ground-state sector; resolve the complete degenerate manifold as required.
candidates.observable_normalization: S(q)=Ncell^-1 sum_ij exp[iq(ri-rj)]<S_i dot S_j>, where S_i sums both orbital spins; translate the paper normalization explicitly.
candidates.oracle: Daghofer et al. finite-cluster structure-factor data.
candidates.acceptance: At the identical finite cluster and interactions, peak ordering matches and normalized values agree within 0.02 or source digitization errors, with explicit eigenpair residual checks.

resources.unknowns: Hilbert-space symmetry reduction, ground-space certification and added local interaction terms.

candidates.adapter_status: NOT_SUPPORTED_CURRENT_INTRAORBITAL_ONLY_MODEL: implement and independently verify the full published interaction first.
candidates.overlap_note: A full-Hund-model scientific target, not evidence already supplied by the current U-only ALM package; one magnetic pattern, not one test per q.

candidates.title: Spin and orbital symmetry of the leading two-electron addition channel
candidates.question: Recover which normalized pair operator couples most strongly to the doped ground state.
candidates.model_geometry: Same published two-orbital finite cluster, comparing undoped N and electron-doped N+2 with the full published interactions.
candidates.ensemble: Certified fixed-number ground states/subspaces and their spin and spatial symmetry labels.
candidates.observable_normalization: Squared pair-addition matrix elements using the exact published operator normalization; compare interorbital B2g singlet and A2g triplet channels without mixing conventions.
candidates.oracle: Daghofer et al. pairing-channel identification and finite-cluster overlaps.
candidates.acceptance: Correct spin/irrep channel wins at each registered paper point; operator overlaps agree within 0.02 absolute after ground-subspace sums and source-reading uncertainty.

resources.unknowns: N+2 Hilbert spaces, symmetry labels and complete pairing operator construction.

candidates.adapter_status: NOT_SUPPORTED_CURRENT_INTRAORBITAL_ONLY_MODEL: requires full interaction plus pair-addition observables and certified doped states.
candidates.overlap_note: Distinct pairing-selection question from magnetic stripe correlations. Do not infer superconductivity in the thermodynamic limit from a finite-cluster overlap.
